tasks.short: Participate in medicinal preparation research or production

steps.what: Participate in research, development or manufacturing of medicinal and pharmaceutical preparations

tasks.design: Retain authorised technical participation in preparation research or production. Current procedures in {DOCS} support the work; laboratory records and drafting tools do not replace handling materials or conducting the scientific process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical work depends on physical conditions, protocols and scientific supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: No relevant validated process replacement is supplied in the digest.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected process behaviour and context-specific technical decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise departures and seek scientific direction within the authorised protocol.
tasks.altitude: Technical participation and authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Protocol boundaries and clear scientific escalation

evidence.claim: Research or production participation remains physical and contextual work; report-generation cases do not establish process labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is hands-on technical participation, excluding separately counted experiment monitoring, database entry and report writing. Research, development and manufacturing are alternative settings rather than three mandatory sequential phases.

Responsible scientist supplies existing authorised instructions; technician produces observations during the fully retained work. No structured process-success flag or autonomous production instruction is assumed.
Use native protocol access first. No changed process creates upkeep; applicable regulated-process requirements remain customer facts.
research_questions: Which operations require direct technician attention even when records are electronic?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Technical operations retain full time; record and reporting savings belong to separate tasks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyse experimental data and report findings

steps.what: Analyze experimental data and interpret results against protocol and source evidence
Write experimental reports and summaries from the verified findings

loop.purpose: Draft findings prose without changing the scientific interpretation
loop.input: Technician's verified findings, approved analysis tables and explicit limitations
loop.output: Source-linked report draft with tables inserted unchanged
loop.check: Technician checks each conclusion, comparison and qualification against actual results, protocol scope and the findings brief
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported conclusions or contradictory evidence require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native table export and templates first; varied experimental explanations need contextual prose

steps.what: Check the findings report and submit the exact revision to research personnel

tasks.design: Export checked analysis from scientific analysis software {OTHER} into a native {DOCS} template, then use a bounded draft for the technician's established findings. The technician retains analysis and interpretation, verifies generated meaning and submits the exact report for scientific review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tables and findings wording are assembled separately after analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked report drafting can reuse checked findings without making scientific decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected results, causal overstatement and omitted limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise which conclusions the experiment actually supports.
tasks.altitude: Less report prose assembly; scientific interpretation and review responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Trace claims to protocol, analysis and observations

evidence.claim: Benchling AI structures research documents and drafts study reports, supporting scientific document drafting capability without proving this task's saving.

assumptions: Boundary is data analysis, interpretation and technician report submission, excluding original collection and database entry, already counted separately. Research-personnel scientific approval remains existing outside work and is not shortened or transferred.

Technician produces experiment IDs, dataset revision, analysis method/version, checked tables, findings, comparison scope, limitations and source references in s1; all 40 hours retain analysis, judgement and capture. Native analysis software supplies calculated tables as existing runtime, earning no new saving. Missing evidence leads to explicit gaps or manual writing.

Test native reports and templates first. Four focal upkeep hours cover report mappings and draft exceptions; two system-owner hours cover access and template links. Regulated submissions require separately confirmed review routes and are not autonomously issued.
research_questions: Does draft review preserve uncertainty and avoid unsupported causal conclusions while reducing total writing time?

already_counted.description: Analysis, interpretation and structured findings capture

incremental.description: Report mapping and draft exception upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact report revision, dataset and method versions, tables, conclusions, limitations and recipient; edits void submission approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+18+30=88, gross=12, upkeep=4, net=8. High assumes 40% less report-writing stage effort after semantic review; low requires fully manual prose for unusual results plus upkeep. Analysis, interpretation and final checking retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct or supervise biological operational programmes

steps.what: Conduct or supervise operational programs in hatchery, protected crop or livestock settings

tasks.design: Retain hands-on programme conduct and supervision. Existing operating guidance in {DOCS} supports the role; records software does not replace biological observation, work coordination or operational responses.
tasks.previous_blocker: Biological operations change with organism condition and local circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest offers no general operational-programme replacement.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected biological changes and competing operational needs.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt programme actions to real conditions and coordinate people responsibly.
tasks.altitude: Operational and supervisory time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Programme conduct and supervision remain contextual work; agricultural task maps do not establish a replacement across hatchery, protected crop and livestock operations.

assumptions: Boundary is technician programme conduct or supervision, excluding separately counted record entry and staff execution. Settings are alternatives, and actual overlapping operational tasks must be allocated once in roll-up.
Technician produces operational observations and decisions during retained work. No structured animal or crop condition feed or autonomous action contract is assumed.
Use native operating guidance first. No introduced workflow adds upkeep.
research_questions: Which programme activities depend on direct observation and immediate coordination?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Operational conduct and supervision retain full time; existing control-system runtime is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide technical support to scientists and engineers

steps.what: Clarify scientists' or engineers' technical support needs and authorised scope
Provide technical support and services within the agreed scientific scope

tasks.design: Retain request clarification and actual scientific technical assistance. Existing procedures in {DOCS} support delivery; a general answer desk cannot stand in for unspecified laboratory or field services.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical services vary with the research question and conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No specific repeatable support component is established by the broad task statement.
tasks.still_hard: Unfamiliar technical problems and limits of the agreed remit.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what can be resolved locally and what needs specialist direction.
tasks.altitude: Technical service work and authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Precise technical briefs and escalation limits

evidence.claim: Broad scientific technical support cannot be assigned a repeatable administrative saving without identifying the actual service; this is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is general support coordination and assistance not already assigned to experiment operation, data entry or report tasks. The roll-up must allocate actual support actions once rather than sum overlapping task labels.

Requesting professional produces the technical request through existing discussion; technician clarifies it in s1 with full time retained. No pre-existing structured troubleshooting diagnosis or universal support catalogue is assumed.
Use native procedures first. No introduced process adds upkeep; a later narrow service pilot needs its own observed baseline.
research_questions: Which specific support request repeats enough to justify a bounded redesign after overlap is removed?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+70=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Request clarification and technical service retain full time; no generic documentation share is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A bounded report-drafting gain is possible; scientific interpretation, technical operations and programme supervision retain their effort.
reach: Clarify technical requirements with medical scientists
Coordinate biological programme work with agricultural technicians
role.ambitious_version: A biological technician with clearer source-linked reports who retains hands-on scientific work and professional escalation.
